entities.name: Rus'–Byzantine War of 907
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: According to the Primary Chronicle, the fleet of Rus' under Oleg the Wise carried out a military strike against Byzantium in 907, landing a huge army in Thrace and beginning to plunder it, following which the Byzantines offered peace to the Rus'.
